### Honesty and Purity
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/honesty-and-purity
Passage: Psalm 101:3-4
Points:
- King David firmly resolved to avoid unworthy ambitions and to choose God's path over evil practices.
- Refusing to dwell on worthless things keeps believers from drifting away from fellowship with the Lord.
- Guarding personal purity requires turning away from curiosity about wickedness and perverse influences.
- Living with moral integrity serves as a spiritual investment that blesses future generations.
- Maintaining innocence is far better than carrying lingering memories of past corruption.

### Godly Resolve
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/godly-resolve
Passage: Psalm 101:1-8
Points:
- True Christian devotion and resolve flow from gratitude for God's saving grace rather than self-righteous effort.
- David framed his commitment to personal godliness only after praising God's steadfast love and justice.
- Pursuing holiness involves actively rooting out hidden sins of the heart rather than merely maintaining outward appearances.
- Godly leaders must refuse to gaze upon worthless things and must remove deceit from their households.
- Believers cannot stand against temptation in their own strength and must continually rely on Christ.
